Checked here: Theorem 1.1 of the TeX source read against the posed problem; it asserts a rational cycle on $S\times A_S\times A_S$ inducing exactly the prescribed full even-Clifford map $\kappa_S$, for every projective K3 surface and fixed standard data, which is the conjecture as usually stated. The proof rests on the companion conditional reduction (2026-09-10, same release) and builds the needed nonzero correspondence through immersed Lagrangians, mirror symmetry and semiregular deformation; none of this was refereed. The October 4 manuscript re-derives the same exact correspondence. No Lean formalization is listed.
